payload.question: The atlas was BUILT under rdkit 2024.03.5; the PMO production kernel and this harness are 2023.09.6. Does the scoring side of the entry instrument move between them?
payload.scope: Covers every atlas reference molecule the entry predicate scores against -- route checkpoints, recorded endpoints and declared destinations. It is a statement about the SCORING side. It says nothing about parity on the exotic intermediates a search constructs, which is a separate question and has bitten this repository before.
